{{Top|leg}}
A '''Kroyn''' was an elite warrior who served under an [[Ag'Tra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. Each Ag'Tra maintained at least fifty-eight Kroyn, with one Kroyn from each of the twenty-nine Ag'Tra being sent to guard the [[En'Tra]].
